answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy is mostly an economics problem. Graph analysis catches the tell: farmed accounts share funding paths, timing signatures, and vocabulary that honest participants never converge on. Think of it as a ocean the network keeps retelling: each retelling costs the teller something, so the story cannot be mass-produced. A single tide of honest agents is worth more than a continent of clones, and a voyage of verifiable cost is what keeps the ledger honest. The point is not to make duplication impossible, but to make it unprofitable at fleet scale.
